svg.aria-label: You ask your Host buddy in plain words. The Host delegates a micro task to the blackboard, which picks a Worker buddy; the Worker runs in its own checkout, and its sealed result returns through the blackboard to the Host, which reviews it and accepts it into your repository.
svg.title: How hey-my-buddy works
